disclaimer: This timeline describes what research says about ejaculatory abstinence in general. It cannot measure your body. Individual semen quality can only be measured by a laboratory semen analysis.

phases.title: Reset & Recovery
phases.summary: Your reproductive system continues producing sperm continuously. Nothing has been 'lost' and nothing needs to be 'rebuilt'.

phases.title: Short Abstinence
phases.summary: Semen volume and the number of sperm available at ejaculation may begin increasing.

phases.title: Continued Abstinence
phases.summary: Longer abstinence is generally associated with greater semen volume and count. Other parameters do not necessarily improve. This is also the window laboratories use to standardise samples.

phases.title: Longer Abstinence
phases.summary: More abstinence does not automatically mean 'better sperm'. Research has associated longer intervals with trade-offs, including lower progressive motility and higher DNA fragmentation. Your commitment is your own; the biology is not a scoreboard.
